Yes—both code findings are closed. I found no concrete remaining problem within these two fixes.

- **Architecture:** Both Dockerfiles enforce target and runtime architecture before apt (`scripts/container/Dockerfile:5`, `Dockerfile.arm64:5`); `verify_packages.py:13` also checks both against the lock. The retained rejection log shows the mismatched target failing with exit 1 at the first RUN (`artifacts/docker/h05-wrong-platform-rejected.log:29`). The matching build verifies all 496 packages and exports successfully.
- **JACK acceptance:** `tests/container_jack_emulation.cjs:12–20` requires client activation and advancing frame time; lines 54–60 repeat checks over ten seconds and require stopped exit 0. Startup/client timeouts fail. The inspected report records six passing variants, 42 successful client connections, and six clean exits. The earlier parsing failure remains false.

Every referenced artifact hash in both evidence manifests matched. Git history confirms no DSP/input/lease changes since `5366789`; the rebuilt-image cancellation/reopen report also passes.

**CONFIDENCE: High.** This conclusion rests on inspected code and retained evidence; I ran no native tests.
